description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain that prides itself on dough made fresh in-house from 100% Canadian wheat, organic tomato sauce, and ingredients free of artificial colours and flavours. The North Vancouver location operates out of a unit in a commercial complex and offers online ordering and phone ordering for pickup. The menu includes a notable range of plant-based, dairy-free, and meat-free options alongside conventional pizzas, salads, and sides.
